output.one_liner: One API to seamlessly integrate with Pinterest for planning content, managing ads, uploading product feeds, and analyzing data.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows. HTTP Basic Authentication required for token endpoint using client_id and client_secret.

evidence.snippet: Build a working authentication flow based on OAuth 2
OAuth grant type selection. The grant type determines how your app authenticates and acquires authorization.
Use HTTP Basic Authentication: Username: client_id Password: client_secret

access.notes: Any developer can self-serve register an app via My apps, but Trial access requires Pinterest's approval. Trial is free but limited to Sandbox (Pins and Boards invisible to non-creator). Standard access for production use requires additional approval with video demo.

evidence.snippet: Submit your request for trial access. Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest.
If your app is approved for Trial access, you can log into your account and manage your app details.
Sandbox: Our sandbox environment allows you to make test calls without impacting the Pinterest product environment.
All Pins and Boards created with Trial access are only visible to their creator as Sandbox entities.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Trial: daily rate limits per app category. Standard: per-minute limits per user per app.

evidence.snippet: Apps with Trial access are rate limited based on calls per day per app.
Pinterest is a visual discovery platform. Tools: 27. Auth: OAUTH2
Pinterest MCP is on the way. Build faster with the Pinterest MCP

buildability.rationale: API is well-documented with broad REST surface; self-serve app registration available but requires approval; Trial limited to Sandbox; production requires Standard tier approval.

overview_evidence.snippet: One API to seamlessly integrate with Pinterest. Securely plan content, manage ads, upload product feeds.
Pinterest is a visual discovery platform for finding ideas like recipes, home and style inspiration.

unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI specification URL not documented. API webhooks not documented (only web widgets mentioned).
unknown_reasons.mcp: Official MCP server announced as forthcoming but release date and details unknown. Community MCP servers not found in provided pages.
